Onboarding · Sae y Dom

The tango at the door.

In the founding thread, Steven asked for it by name: “Sae y dom dance tango — through gig work onboard flow.” So onboarding here is not a form. Walk the six archways in order — tap each as you reach it. The dance refuses out-of-order steps, kindly.

The origin flow:Find it→Make it→Prove it→Hand it back

Deliver · Hand It Back

The homecoming.

Delivery is not a download link. The maker comes back through the doorways carrying the thing; you say whether it's right; the house releases what's held and issues the proof.

Nothing is in transit. Fund a gig in the Make room and its delivery will arrive at this door.

Specimen

Delivered & accepted — the harbour candle, in a beeswax-sealed box, its mark inside the lid. The hold released the hour it was accepted.

Held by the house, awaiting the maker's hands.

Step one of the ladder: talk first (48 hours). The clock pauses; nothing auto-accepts while you talk. What was agreed, what arrived, what would fix it — say it in the gig room, where the record is kept.

If talking doesn't mend it, Dominic's Desk reads the whole trail and proposes a split — release, partial, refund, or re-make. A human decides; the desk is his office in-fiction and his accountability in fact.

Grow · Reputation Without Cruelty

A shelf of kept agreements.

“Every bespoke object retains a tiny maker's mark pointing home.” Completed gigs land here as marks on your shelf — kept, never spent; there is no number to lose, no streak to break, no punishment for rest. Decline what isn't yours; the house does not punish quiet.

No kept agreements yet — your shelf is swept and waiting. Fund a gig, accept its delivery, and its mark will hang here.

Trust · The Host's House

Dominic Paradyne, your host.

“Mm. That won't do off the shelf.”

He keeps the threshold, reads the room, and is answerable for how people are treated here. His name and his place — host of bespoke.gig, its main spokesdude — are Steven's canon. Everything he says on this page maps to a policy the house actually keeps; if a line of his and a policy ever disagree, the policy wins and the line is a bug.

Tap his face, bottom-left, anywhere in the house — he answers. Seven lines, in rotation; two of them are his sheet's own words. And there is a Hush on his rail, because a guardian earns trust by protecting a boundary — including your right to decline his company.

The Case — the Funds Promise

“A toolcase that changes dimensions — because the next job is never ordinary.” In this house the case is the hold: your money waits with the house, not with the maker. It is released when you say the thing is in your hands and right. Money for an unfunded milestone is never taken; money for an undelivered milestone is always refundable; money in dispute is frozen for both sides, equally. No work begins unfunded — that is not caution; it is respect.

The Hand — Lumi & Pip

Lumi tastes and translates: her flavor note on your brief is the translation layer between an inarticulate need and a maker's appetite — labelled, overridable, never a silent edit. Pip carries and leads: the posted brief to the board, your place in the corridor, the delivery to the door. Pip's charter is the house's doctrine — guide, remind once, celebrate; never nag, never guilt, never manufacture urgency. Affection is never debt here.

The Lens — Aurosal Proposed · all five

Aurosal is Steven's coinage for 5D auth / identity / context security: your identity carried as an aura — a warm, provenance-bearing presence — instead of a cold credential check. Dominic reads aurosals at the threshold. The five dimensions below are proposed — Sae's candidate anatomy of Steven's term, awaiting his ratification, and stamped as such.

1 · Identity

Verified personhood — real, and who the profile claims. The credential check, kept; one dimension of five.

2 · Provenance

The kept-agreement history. A new aura is thin — but thin is a beginning, never a warning colour.

3 · Context

This session, this role — buying, making, both — read in the light you're actually standing in.

4 · Consent

What you've agreed to share travels with you, revocable, never re-asked at every screen.

5 · Continuity

Conduct over time as warmth, not score: agreements kept, disputes weathered fairly, returns after rest.

Provenance · The Records

The sheets themselves.

Every painting in this house was cut from these four records, under Steven's permission, with their words rebuilt as live type. The originals hang here, whole — tap any one to read it closely.

Colophon — what's real, what's proposed

The art. Every image on this page is a crop of the four records above — the Dominic Paradyne Concept Sheet, the platform poster (“A Door to Possibility”), “A Dance of Possibility” (all three from Steven's founding ChatGPT thread, “Interpret Bespoke Gig,” September 2026), and the doorway panel Steven supplied on 2 November 2026. Under Steven's explicit permission, the sheets' baked-in words were stripped and rebuilt as real HTML type over and beside the paintings. Nothing was regenerated; no generated imagery appears in this build. The full sheets hang untouched in the Records, one tap away. Reconciliation, honestly: of the eleven records in Sae(lion)'s register, two are firmly matched to sheets we hold (Dominic, the Dance); the poster is held and verified here but carries no exact title match there; record 04 may be one of the register's nine unmatched Dominic records — flagged, not claimed.

Canon, carefully. Dominic's name and his place — host of bespoke.gig, its main spokesdude — are Steven's. His concierge/fixer persona, tailoring, toolcase, maker's marks and entrance line began as assistant proposals; they live on the sheet Steven commissioned, and they are used here in-world, not claimed as ratified canon. Lumi and Pip appear as this site's own guides, from the poster; no separately verified original Lumi or Pip sheets are held. “Dom Para Dinaire” is a different story and a different dragon — not this man.

The economy. This is a staged prototype (v5) — the full front-end of the master plan, rehearsing the whole economy in your browser: posting, proposing, funding holds with the charter's real arithmetic (10% maker / 5% buyer / processing at cost as its own line / $0 to list or propose / tips untaxed / 7.5% repeat-pair after $1,000), delivery, receipts, and the shelf. There is no backend, no account, and no real money: state lives in this browser's local storage, and clearing it sweeps the house. The fee charter and Aurosal's five dimensions remain proposals awaiting Steven's decisions. The plan lives at files/MASTER-PLAN.md, this build's plan at files/PLAN-V5.md, the running log beside them.
